resources.string: Reads the iPhone\'s own system log while a cabled connection is being set up, keeping accessory and authentication lines for two minutes. Only useful when an MFi handshake fails; leave it off otherwise.

Also writes the audio, video and receive statistics lines, which arrive every few seconds while a stream runs. Only needed while investigating a problem: the log fills and rotates about four times faster, and the stats add nothing once playback is stable.
